purpose: Test whether a depth-two budget plan has value that requires executing both leading structural actions before returning to public greedy.
candidate_rule: Use the consecutive cut/shield prefix from budget_plan depth=2 width=4; a collaborative opportunity requires at least two actions.
rollout_rule: Apply the candidate prefix on PredictiveState, validate each predicted action against its projected public state, then continue public greedy.
response_rule: Use P8 public salt and scenarios 0-4 for selection plus 5-12 for an independent audit; both means must be positive and both minima nonnegative.
execution_rule: The first arm executes only the first structural action; the full arm validates returned public state and executes the complete accepted structural prefix before replanning.
safety: Predictions remain in PredictiveState and never enter Blackboard; every real action is revalidated and Blackboard changes only from returned environment outcomes.
stop_rule: Stop this arm without broader search if there are no length-two structural opportunities, all second actions repeat/collapse prior actions, or full-prefix execution has no attributable advantage over first-only execution on this diagnostic cohort.
